articles.summary: Depa Finance has selected Modern Treasury to power its cross-border payments infrastructure, giving businesses and individuals across 90+ countries access to named U.S. accounts, U.S. payment rails, and stablecoin-native money movement through a single payments API.
articles.title: Depa Finance Selects Modern Treasury to Power Its Stablecoin-Native Cross-Border Payments Infrastructure

articles.summary: Modern Treasury announced that GrowIt selected its Payment Service Provider (PSP) to automate capital collection and investor distributions for real estate syndications. Using Modern Treasury's Payments API, GrowIt streamlines money movement to help sponsors raise and manage capital efficiently.
articles.title: GrowIt Selects Modern Treasury to Power Payments for Real Estate Capital Raises
